complaint: Every evening these kids are playing soccer on the road, it’s annoying and dangerous! Can’t anyone tell them to go to the park and leave the street for cars?

OMG I got takeout from a spot in the East Village and the guy preparing my order had long hair just hanging out! Like, how hard is it to put on a hairnet?! I almost lost my appetite, that’s how bad it was.
Ughhh this parking meter on 7th Ave is totally outta order. Tried to pay but it just beeped at me and then said 'Error!' What am I supposed to do, just risk it and hope I don't get fined?
Hey my neighbors car is parked in front of my driveway again, I get they need to park but come on, its not rocket science, I can't get out and I have to be at work in like 15 mins!

Yo, there’s a huge branch dangling from this tree in front of my building and it’s like just hanging over the power lines. If it falls I’m pretty sure it could take out the whole block! What’s going on?
I don’t know what’s going on but my water has this funky taste and I’m getting kinda paranoid about it, like what’s in it?? Help!

Hey, there's this sign for a new fancy restaurant but it's totally blocking the sidewalk like it’s a wall or something. I had to walk in the street and almost got hit by a bike. Need to move it, it’s ridiculous!

Ugh, why do people think it's okay to just mess with trees? The branch from that tree on 5th Ave is hanging way too low now, like I can barely walk under it without ducking. Can someone please fix it before it takes an eye out?!

Ugh, my bathroom sink pipe is leaking and I don’t know what to do, I just put a towel down to catch the water but it’s still dripping. I’m not a plumber! Can someone fix this before it floods my whole apartment?
I don’t know what is wrong with my neighbors but they are constantly blasting music so loud it makes my dishes rattle! Like, do they even own a volume knob? I hate this!
Ugh, the pedestrian lamp outside of Dunkin' on 8th Street is dead. I’ve seen so many people almost get hit! Can you please send someone to take care of this? Thanks.

The speed limit sign on Riverside Drive is practically upside down. I don’t know how long it’s been like that but people are flying past it like they’re in a race and it’s really scary! Can we get that fixed before someone gets hurt?

Every time I look up in my bedroom all I see is like this ugly peeling paint, I mean c’mon it’s embarrassing, friends are coming over and I don’t want them judging my ceiling, can someone do something??

There’s a huge tree down on 45th St and it’s taking up the whole block! I can’t even get to the subway! This is dangerous, I swear the city needs to do better with these things. Something really needs to be done!
That dumpster by the corner on W 46th is always open and it’s filled with disgusting stuff, feels like a health hazard or something. Can’t believe we gotta deal with that daily!
So there's this constant dripping sound coming from the ceiling in my kitchen. I thought it was just a small issue but now it's a full-on leak and I'm freaking out about water damage. Help!
There’s a pedestrian signal out at 8th Ave and 34th St and it’s driving me nuts! It’s like a game of Frogger trying to cross there. Can’t believe it’s still not fixed after a week!
Went to pick up my prescription, and the lady at the counter refused to refund me for meds I didn't even need anymore! I feel like I’m being robbed, like how can they do that seriously?
Last week I bought a jacket from that trendy spot on the LES and it said $40 but when I paid it was $60! Like, how is that legal? Just be honest about your prices, it’s not that hard.

I just passed by the traffic signal box on 23rd and 8th and it’s totally open. I mean, couldn’t someone just walk by and stick their hand in there? It’s really not safe. Can you send someone to check it out?

So my living room light flooded with water?? Like, what even?! I just bought that lamp last month and now its all wet and sad. Can you please send someone to check it out? I'm so over this place and its bad wiring!
Why is the ramp at 14th and Park so steep? It’s like you gotta climb a hill just to get off the sidewalk! I hate it, and I’m only 5’2, how’s anyone else supposed to manage?

Hey, the traffic light at 5th Ave and 42nd St is out and it’s totally chaos over there. Cars just zooming through like it’s a race or something! I almost got hit walking my dog. Can someone please fix this?!

This parked car in the bus lane on 5th Ave is ridiculous. I can’t believe people think they can just park wherever they want. Buses are honking like crazy and it's making my morning commute a nightmare!
Why is my apartment smelling like a campfire? I thought it was just the neighbor at first but it’s been days! Can’t believe I have to deal with this when I just want to enjoy my coffee.
Why is it that every weekend there’s a bunch of people selling stuff right in front of my building? Like move a few feet! I can’t even walk through without dodging bags and tables, it's ridiculous!

There’s this guy on my floor who's always acting weird and I can smell something odd coming from his apartment. It’s making me uncomfortable and I’m worried about what’s happening. Can someone check it out?
Ugh, this is so frustrating! I can’t believe how many flyers I have to dodge on my way to work. Like, show some respect for our neighborhood! It’s a mess and I want it gone.

I just moved into this apartment and they hit me with all these fees that were NEVER mentioned while signing the lease!!! Like, how am I just supposed to magically know about these extra costs? It's ridiculous!!!

I'm tired of dodging these huge chunks of broken curb every time I walk my dog! Like how long is it gonna take to fix? I feel like I’m navigating an obstacle course out here. Just gotta avoid the crazy potholes and the broken sidewalk too!
My oven pilot light went out and I don't know how to relite it. I've been binge-watching this show and now I can't make dinner! Someone please help!

There's a guy constantly panhandling on my corner and he gets really aggressive sometimes. I’m all for helping people but it’s making everyone around super uncomfortable. Can someone help him find resources or something?
There was a snow plow at the end of my street making an ungodly amount of noise and I swear it felt like it woke the whole block up. Do they really have to do this so early?

I don’t even know if I can trust these car services anymore. I took a ride last night, and the driver was super rude and didn’t even give me a receipt. Like, how am I supposed to keep track of my expenses? This is not how you treat customers, seriously!
So, uh, I think someone took my tennis racquet from the courts at Prospect Park. I went for a quick run to grab water and came back and it just vanished! Who steals a racquet? Like come on!
Why is the park never locked at night? I walked by and it was just sitting there open like an invitation for trouble. This is insane, can’t we keep our kids safe?
The guy who drove me was outright disrespectful, didn't even say a word, just huffed when I told him my destination. Like, come on, I'm not your enemy!
Ugh, my shower won't even switch to the handheld part, like it’s stuck! I can’t wash my hair properly now and I have no idea how to fix it, it’s so annoying!
Yo, can someone do something about the lights in my apartment? They're so dim it feels like I'm living in a cave! I can't even see my hand in front of my face at night, it's ridiculous.
Every time I walk outside I’m hit with this foul smell cause of the pigeons everywhere! My flowers are dying, my nose is unhappy, and I can’t even sit on my porch anymore. Why is this allowed?
